cohort.name: mastitis
cohort.title: External interval-censored validation: Clustered Dairy-Cow Mastitis Cohort
cohort.endpoint: first bacterial infection of an udder quarter

analysis.estimand: Out-of-cow 90% conformal lower prediction-bound performance for time to first udder-quarter infection under the cohort's natural interval-observation process
analysis.primary_predictive_score: held-out natural interval negative log likelihood
analysis.coverage_reporting: partial identification from observed event intervals
analysis.cluster_guardrail: All four udder quarters from a cow remain in the same split and bootstrap unit.

methods.naive_upper: Finite event intervals are coded at the recorded upper endpoint; right censoring is retained.
methods.midpoint: Finite event intervals are coded at their midpoint, with day zero as the lower endpoint for left-censored infections; right censoring is retained.
methods.interval_aware: The log-normal AFT likelihood uses left-, interval-, and right-censored observations directly; calibration uses fitted conditional medians within each observed interval.

gate.supportive_rule: All checks must pass, including a positive lower 95% bootstrap bound for held-out interval-NLL improvement versus naive upper-endpoint coding.
gate.contrary_rule: The upper 95% bootstrap bound for interval-NLL improvement is below zero, or the upper 95% bound for certain-miss reduction is worse than the allowed margin.
